scenarios.name: Public storage bucket
scenarios.asset: Cloud storage bucket containing customer exports
scenarios.control: Block public access and continuously assess storage policies
scenarios.residual_risk: An overly broad trusted identity could still retrieve data.

scenarios.name: Unpatched application server
scenarios.threat: Exploitation of a known vulnerability in the application server
scenarios.control: Restrict administrative access and segment the server network
scenarios.residual_risk: The vulnerable service remains exploitable if reached.

scenarios.name: Container image in registry
scenarios.asset: Container image used by a payment-processing service
scenarios.threat: Deployment of an image containing a known vulnerable package
scenarios.control: Scan images and block releases with critical findings
scenarios.residual_risk: New vulnerabilities may be disclosed after an image is scanned.
